title: Story premise EDU002: The Basement Delivery
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Five floors up from minus two: where do we land? Takeaway/theme: Movement on a number line counts intervals, not the starting position.
description: A courier starts two floors below ground and must rise five floors, but treats the ground-floor label as an extra step. A numbered elevator track exposes the counting error and delivers the parcel to floor three.
